items.source: Create a resolver instance with the given MessageConverter.
items.translation: 使用给定的MessageConverter创建解析器实例。

items.source: By default this is the generic type declared in the Message method parameter but that can be overridden to select a more specific target type after also taking into account the "Content-Type", for example, return String if target type is Object and "Content-Type:text/**".
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是 `Message` 方法参数中声明的泛型类型，但可以在考虑"Content-Type"后覆盖它以选择更具体的目标类型，例如，如果目标类型是 `Object` 且 `"Content-Type:text/**"`，则返回 `String`。

items.source: HandlerMethodArgumentResolver for Message method arguments. Validates that the generic type of the payload matches to the message value or otherwise applies MessageConverter to convert to the expected payload type.
items.translation: HandlerMethodArgumentResolver 用于 Message 方法参数。验证有效负载的泛型类型是否与消息值匹配，否则应用 MessageConverter 将其转换为预期的有效负载类型。

items.source: Check if the given payload is empty.
Whether the given method parameter is supported by this resolver.
items.translation: 给定方法参数是否由该解析器支持。

items.source: Create a default resolver instance without message conversion.
items.translation: 创建一个不带消息转换的默认解析器实例。

items.source: Resolves a method parameter into an argument value from a given message.
items.translation: 将方法参数解析为来自给定消息的参数值。

items.source: converter - the MessageConverter to use (may be null)
payload - the payload to check (can be null)

items.source: true if this resolver supports the supplied parameter; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此解析器支持提供的参数；否则为 false。
